title: Where AI meets economist intelligence: a practical tour
gist: Promotional webinar listing for Oxford Economics' client-only AskOE AI agent suite; no research content, only product descriptions.

insights.claim: Oxford Economics says that in twelve months its research, data and models have moved from reports to tools that clients can question directly through AI agents.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Research providers are productising AI agents, signalling subscription-model change for macro research.

insights.claim: The agent suite includes AskOE AI for sourced answers, Executive Lens for role-specific briefings, Business Forecast linking indicators to client sales drivers, and an AI Scenario Assistant for testing alternative outcomes.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Competitive benchmark for AI-enabled research products.
